Title: Integer Variable
Code: int count = 42;
Explain: Declares an integer variable named count and assigns it the value 42.

Title: String Variable
Code: string name = "Alice";
Explain: Declares a string variable and assigns a literal value.

Title: Boolean Expression
Code:
bool isReady = true;
bool isValid = count > 0 && count < 100;
Explain: Declares two boolean variables.
The second uses a compound logical expression with && operator.

Title: Array Declaration
Code:
int[] scores = { 90, 85, 72, 98 };
double average = scores.Average();
Explain: Initializes an int array with four values.
Calls the LINQ Average extension method.

Title: String Interpolation
Explain: Uses string interpolation with the $ prefix to combine first and last names.
Writes the result to standard output.

Title: Simple If-Else
Explain: Checks whether the temperature exceeds 25.
Assigns a different message depending on the branch taken.

Title: Simple Static Method
Explain: Defines a static method that returns the sum of two integers.
Calls the method and prints the result using string interpolation.

Title: For Loop with Accumulator
Explain: Iterates from 1 to 10, accumulating the running total.
Prints the final sum which equals 55.

Title: Switch Expression
Explain: Uses a switch expression to map an integer to a day name.
The discard pattern _ acts as the default case.

Title: Null Coalescing
Explain: Uses the ?? operator to provide fallback values for nullable types.
Both string? and int? demonstrate nullable reference and value types.

Title: Foreach with List
Explain: Iterates over a list of names and filters those with more than 3 characters.
Converts matching names to uppercase and collects them in a second list.

Title: LINQ Where and Select
Explain: Filters even numbers from the array using Where.
Squares each result with Select and materializes to an array.

Title: Dictionary Lookup
Explain: Creates a dictionary with indexer-style initialization.
Uses TryGetValue with an out parameter for safe lookup.

Title: While Loop with Break
Explain: Processes items from a queue until a sentinel value is encountered.
The break statement exits the loop when STOP is found.

Title: Try-Catch-Finally
Explain: Wraps integer division in a try-catch to handle divide-by-zero.
The finally block runs regardless of whether an exception occurred.

Title: Record with Deconstruct
Explain: Defines a positional record with an instance method.
Positional records automatically generate a Deconstruct method for tuple-style decomposition.

Title: Class with Properties and Constructor
Explain: Defines a class with mixed property accessibility.
Includes a constructor, a mutation method, and an overridden ToString.

Title: LINQ GroupBy
Explain: Groups a list of value tuples by customer name.
Projects each group into an anonymous type with aggregated totals.

Title: Interface Implementation
Explain: Defines an interface with a property and a method.
Circle implements the interface using expression-bodied members.

Title: Enum with Extension Method
Explain: Defines an enum for log severity levels.
An extension method maps each level to a console color using a switch expression.

Title: Generic Repository
Explain: A generic repository with a class constraint.
Uses Func delegates for flexible querying and removal.

Title: Async File Reader
Explain: Reads a file asynchronously line by line.
Splits each line into words, trims punctuation, and counts occurrences in a case-insensitive dictionary.

Title: Event Publisher
Explain: A sensor class fires an event when the temperature changes beyond a threshold.
Subscribers attach via a lambda that prints the new reading.

Title: Async Parallel Tasks
Explain: Sends HTTP requests to multiple URLs in parallel.
Each task returns the content length or -1 on failure, collected via Task.WhenAll.

Title: IDisposable Pattern
Explain: Implements IDisposable to release a byte buffer.
Uses ObjectDisposedException.ThrowIf for guarded access after disposal.

Title: Expression-Bodied Fluent Builder
Explain: A fluent query builder that chains method calls to construct a SQL string.
Each setter method returns this to enable chaining, and Build assembles the final query.

Title: LINQ Expression Tree
Explain: Dynamically builds a predicate using the System.Linq.Expressions API.
Constructs a lambda that checks equality on a named property, then compiles it to a delegate.

Title: Channel Producer-Consumer
Explain: Sets up a bounded channel for backpressure-aware producer-consumer.
The producer writes integers, the consumer reads them asynchronously and squares each value.

Title: Delegate Chain with Middleware
Explain: Builds a middleware pipeline by composing delegates in reverse order.
Each middleware wraps the next delegate, enabling request/response processing patterns.

Title: Custom LINQ Operator
Explain: Implements a Batch extension method that partitions a sequence into fixed-size chunks.
Uses yield return for lazy evaluation and emits the final partial batch.

Title: Pattern Matching State Machine
Explain: Models order lifecycle states as a record hierarchy.
Uses tuple pattern matching on (state, action) to enforce valid state transitions.
A secondary switch destructures each state for display.

Title: Generic Pipeline with Async Transforms
Explain: A type-safe async pipeline that chains transforms with cancellation support.
Each Then call captures the previous stage in a closure, composing async functions.
WithTimeout wraps the pipeline with a linked CancellationTokenSource.

Title: Recursive Tree with Pattern Matching
Explain: Models a simple expression language with records for the AST.
The evaluator uses deeply nested pattern matching with property patterns and nested switch expressions.
LetIn introduces variable bindings by extending the environment dictionary.
